new_scholarship.notes: Programme statistics published by KI: 1,002 applicants and 12 awardees in 2026; 687 applicants and 10 awardees in 2025. KI notes that scholarship applications are submitted before admission results are published, so applicant numbers are higher than the number of admitted students and should not be read as the number of eligible candidates. In 2026 a total of 484 fee-paying students were admitted to KI's master's programmes.
new_scholarship.description: The KI Global Master's Scholarship is awarded by Karolinska Institutet to tuition fee-paying students admitted to one of its global master's programmes, with the award distributed across all global master's programmes and decided on the merit rating from the KI CV form, where the highest-rated applicant in each programme wins and ties are resolved by lottery. The scholarship covers tuition fees only - living expenses, accommodation and travel must be funded by the student. Applicants must rank a KI programme as their first choice, remain eligible even if admitted to a lower-ranked KI option, and be admitted, since only admitted students enter the final selection. The joint programmes in Molecular Techniques in Life Science and Biostatistics and Data Science are excluded. The published application window for the 2027 cycle is 8 to 24 February 2027, with results on 26 April 2027 and an acceptance deadline of 30 April 2027.
